chat: A conversation: a question about a document and an answer with numbered citations.
sources: The sources panel next to an answer: the cited passages with their document and page.
start: The start screen with a question box and the choice of what to search.
groups: A group of documents with its conversations and the list of its PDFs.
document: A document page with the chunks the text was split into and their statistics.
search-lab: The search lab: results of vector search, full-text search and their combination side by side.
mobile-chat: The conversation on a phone: the answer and its citations fit a narrow screen.
settings: The settings dialog: language, appearance and personal context for answers.
hero-chat: A conversation: a question about a document and an answer with numbered citations.
about-sources: The sources panel next to an answer: the cited passages with their document and page.
how-flow: A question asked with a PDF attached: the file under the question and an answer about it with numbered citations.
